# CodePipelineProcessContextEntryKind

What a transcript entry of a code pipeline run holds.

**Kind:** a string enum, used in responses.

## Values

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `"Text"` | Text the agent wrote. |
| `"Thinking"` | The agent's thinking (reasoning). |

New values can appear, so treat one you don't know as "something else", not as an error.

## Where it's used

- Inside [`CodePipelineProcessContextEntry`](code-pipeline-process-context-entry.md)
